NL: What are all the distinct details of the customers?

Axioms.axiom1: ∀a0∀a1∀a0'∀a1'( Customers(a0, a1) ∧ Customers(a0', a1') ∧ a0 = a0' ) → ( a1 = a1' )
Axioms.axiom2: ∀b0∀b1∀b2∀b3∀b4∀b0'∀b1'∀b2'∀b3'∀b4'( Customer_Policies(b0, b1, b2, b3, b4) ∧ Customer_Policies(b0', b1', b2', b3', b4') ∧ b0 = b0' ) → ( b1 = b1' ∧ b2 = b2' ∧ b3 = b3' ∧ b4 = b4' )
Axioms.axiom6: ∀b0∀b1∀b2∀b3∀b4 ( Customer_Policies(b0, b1, b2, b3, b4) → ∃a0∃a1 ( Customers(a0, a1) ∧ a0 = b1 ) )
Axioms.axiom7: ∀c0∀c1∀c2∀c3∀c4∀c5 ( Claims(c0, c1, c2, c3, c4, c5) → ∃b0∃b1∃b2∃b3∃b4 ( Customer_Policies(b0, b1, b2, b3, b4) ∧ b0 = c1 ) )
Axioms.axiom8: ∀d0∀d1∀d2∀d3∀d4∀d5∀d6 ( Settlements(d0, d1, d2, d3, d4, d5, d6) → ∃c0∃c1∃c2∃c3∃c4∃c5 ( Claims(c0, c1, c2, c3, c4, c5) ∧ c0 = d1 ) )
Axioms.axiom9: ∀e0∀e1∀e2∀e3∀e4 ( Payments(e0, e1, e2, e3, e4) → ∃d0∃d1∃d2∃d3∃d4∃d5∃d6 ( Settlements(d0, d1, d2, d3, d4, d5, d6) ∧ d0 = e1 ) )
